decls.name: UnramifiedProPTowerFields

paper_span.quote: Then \(F_j/F\) is finite Galois, everywhere unramified, and has \(3\)-group Galois group; since

decls.rationale: Supplies the tower layers themselves: the fixed field of an open normal subgroup of \(\mathrm{Gal}(F^{\mathrm{ur},3}/F)\) is a finite Galois everywhere-unramified 3-extension of `F`.
